Product Tank Accounting

Remember to account for the product tank! This typically adds 2–4 pallets, depending on the tank size and gallon type (Regular vs. QS).

Example (Line 7): Add 2 pallets for regular gallons. However, if running QS, you must add 4 pallets total (due to the 2x multiplier). Therefore, call 'last 4' for QS and 'last 2' for regular gallons. Ensure these are added to the total syrup count for the entire run. Note that tank sizes vary by line.

Calculator Tip: All fields are bi-directional. You can also type math directly into any box (e.g. =506*24/30) and press Enter.
